units.source_text: 我還會把男傭和女傭召集到房間裡，讓一位男傭坐在鋼琴前亂彈一通

en.t: I would also gather the male and female servants in the room and have one of the men sit at the piano and bang away at random.

units.source_text: （雖然是在鄉下，但家裡該有的都配得很全），我則伴隨著那亂七八糟的曲調，

en.t: Although we were in the countryside, the house was furnished with just about everything it needed, and to that chaotic tune,

units.source_text: 跳起了印第安舞，逗得大家捧腹大笑。

en.t: I would launch into an Indian dance and make everyone roar with laughter.

units.source_text: 二哥開啟鎂光燈，拍下我的印第安舞姿，等照片洗出來一看，

en.t: My second brother set off the flash and photographed me doing my Indian dance, and when the picture was developed,

units.source_text: 發現腰布的縫合處（其實是一塊印花的包袱罩），竟露出了我的小雞雞，

en.t: we found that my little willy was showing through the seam of my loincloth, which was actually a printed wrapping cloth,

units.source_text: 又惹得全家人鬨堂大笑。

en.t: and that set the whole family laughing all over again.

units.source_text: 這或許說得上是一次意外的成功吧。

en.t: Perhaps that could be called an accidental success.
